title: Raising the cup at the Long Table's head — the capstone of the fully-prepared 'resting way' (all three toasts known, last course served) — is still gated behind a will roll (DC10, 1hp on fail) rather than an automatic success once every prerequisite is met; a fully-prepared Scholar can still whiff the finale on a bad roll, though the fail cost here is trivial.
